name: Ritz-Carlton, Istanbul
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton, Istanbul, a hotel in the Dolmabahçe area overlooking the Bosphorus, with Nobu, Anatolian and Italian restaurants and a spa with a Turkish hammam
best_for: Travelers who want Bosphorus views and a Turkish hammam spa
Families who want a kids program with excursions

facts.text: The hotel is in the Dolmabahçe area, overlooking the Bosphorus.
Nobu Istanbul, the hotel's Nobu restaurant, serves Japanese-Peruvian cuisine.
Limoré is the hotel's Italian restaurant.
The Roof shows open-air cinema evenings every Tuesday from June to September.
The hotel offers a private Bosphorus yacht cruise that departs from Kabataş İskelesi.
The hotel runs a Ritz Kids program with tailored excursions to Istanbul attractions.
Club Lounge food is presented five times daily.
Club guests can have Turkish coffee brewed in hot sand every Wednesday.
Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel among its Readers' Choice Awards for 2017, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026.

highlights.text: The Nobu Suite has a private terrace with an ofuro soaking tub overlooking the Bosphorus.
The spa's hammam is modeled after the 16th-century Turkish baths of Roxelana and has a couple's suite.
Atölye's plates use produce grown in the hotel's own vegetable garden.
The Roof is a rooftop terrace with an infinity pool and views of the Bosphorus.
Room decor reflects Turkish culture and Ottoman times, with tulips and İznik tiles.

considerations.text: The outdoor infinity pool is available during the summer period.
Club access requires an upgraded booking.
WhataHotel notes the formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: The Ritz-Carlton, Istanbul
